definition: the schema vocabulary — the single source of truth for event types, statuses, gates, and artifact types (resource-registry spec: one registry per class, no layer duplicates). Machine-readable form of journey-format-spec v14 §3, plus (v4, leg 12/08) the DECISION mapping gateDecisions: the human input accept|reject <-> the recorded events confirmed|rejected (a RECONCILED pair — the derivation reads the code literal GATE_DECISION_EVENTS; §5), plus (v5, leg 12/08 rework) the status word `rework`: the DERIVED word for a task owing a re-submission at a rejected gate (workflow.ts's projection derives it; a re-submission clears it). It is NOT a closed word (the leg aggregate / leg gate / distance-to-goal still count the task as open work) and NOT a ready one (the ready set {queued, active} excludes it, so no reader proposes it). Data-or-code is PER KEY (resource-registry v3 §5): artifactTypes is ADJUSTABLE DATA — each entry carries the docs/ category it places into and whether it takes a -v<N> filename (format v14 §14/§15); eventTypes, statuses and the gate SET/POSITIONS are PROTECTED — enforced as code literals and recorded as reconciliations. Consumers read; never hardcode.
